eases.hold: the value of the key before, until this frame

channels.root.rot: deg about the ground point, + leans to screen right
channels.head.rot: deg about the chin, + tilts to screen right
channels.eye.sy: scale of both eyes, 1 open, 0.12 shut
channels.tail.rot: deg, - curls in and up, + drops outward
channels.pawL.rot: deg about the shoulder, screen-left leg, + lifts outward
channels.pawR.rot: deg about the shoulder, screen-right leg, - lifts outward

idle.name: Idle
idle.intent: Sitting, looking at you. The head rocks from side to side and the tail swishes when it feels like it.
beats: 0-60: one breath, 1.8% of its height.
0-60: the head rocks 4 degrees each way, once.
6-16: the tail flicks in 14 degrees in 4 frames, then swings out past rest.
30-44: a second, smaller swish.
36-46: the right ear flicks out 16 degrees in 2 frames and springs back.
50-55: one blink.

listening.name: Listening
listening.intent: Pops up tall with the ears in, and flips its head from one tilt to the other while you talk.
beats: Enter, 5 frames, overshoot: the head rises 10 pt, the ears turn in, the tail goes up and holds.
0-14: head tilted 11 degrees to the right. Held.
14-18: the head flips to 11 degrees left in 4 frames, with overshoot. The ears follow 2 frames late and spring.
32-36: it flips back.
Live: add the microphone level times 6 degrees to both ears, turning in.

thinking.name: Thinking
thinking.intent: Looks up at one corner, then the other, tapping its tail to count.
beats: 0-20: the eyes look up and left, the head tilts right, the left ear droops. The tail taps 3 times, 10 degrees, every 6 frames.
20-26: the eyes cross to the other corner; the head and the ears swap sides.
26-42: held, with 2 more taps.
42-48: back to the first side.

working.name: Working
working.intent: Kneading. The front paws press in turn, twice a second each, and the body rocks with them.
beats: Enter, 8 frames: the head drops 8 pt and the eyes look down at the paws.
0-6: the left paw lifts 10 pt and presses down. 6-12: the right paw.
12-24: the same again.
The body leans 2 degrees toward the paw that presses.
0-24: the tail swings 12 degrees each way, twice.
18-22: one blink.

subagents.name: Subagents
subagents.intent: Three dots hop past on its left, one for each subagent running. It watches them and bats at the nearest.
beats: Enter, 8 frames: the dots fade in; the head tilts toward them and the eyes go left.
0-8, 12-20, 24-32: each dot hops 14 pt in turn.
8-18: the left paw swipes out 34 degrees with overshoot and comes back.
32-42: a second, smaller swipe.
0-48: the tail swings 14 degrees each way, twice.

speaking.name: Speaking
speaking.intent: No mouth. The head bobs on each syllable and tips a little the other way each time.
beats: 0, 6, 12, 19: four syllables in an uneven rhythm. The head drops 3 to 6 pt in 3 frames and eases back up.
The tilt changes side on each syllable, 4 degrees.
The ears bounce outward 2 frames after each bob.
The body rises 1.2% on the two strong syllables (3 and 15).
Live: scale the bob by the speech level instead of playing the loop.

needs.name: Needs You
needs.intent: Waves at you. One paw up, three waves, and a small bounce to make sure you saw.
beats: 0-2: the right paw presses in 4 degrees (anticipation).
2-8: it swings out and up 138 degrees with overshoot, to beside the head; the head tilts toward it.
8-26: three waves, 20 degrees each.
26-32: held. 28-36: a bounce, 8 pt off the ground, landing with a 4% squash.
36-42: the paw comes down. 42-48: at rest.
0-48: the tail swings 10 degrees each way, twice.

approval.name: Approval
approval.intent: The crouch before a pounce. Eyes wide and fixed on the card, then the wiggle.
beats: Enter, 4 frames, snap, no overshoot: it drops 5% lower, the head 6 pt down, the ears turned in, the eyes 20% wider.
0-26: frozen. No blink.
26-40: the wiggle. The body shifts 4 pt left and right every 2 frames, and the tail tip twitches with it.
40-48: frozen again.
Allowed: play Done (the pounce it was waiting for). Denied: play the entry to Idle.

blocked.name: Blocked
blocked.intent: Something failed. The ears go flat out to the sides, the head sinks and the tail drops.
beats: Enter, 12 frames: the figure sinks 5% and the head 10 pt.
0-10: a shudder, 3 pt side to side, dying out.
10-30: a slow breath in.
30-48: the sigh out, to 94% of its height.
36-44: the left ear lifts 14 degrees and springs flat again.
The eyes stay half shut and look down.

done.name: Done
done.intent: A jump with both paws in the air, then a happy head tilt. The tail goes four times a second.
beats: 0-4: squash to 90% (anticipation).
4-10: launch. It stretches to 105%, leaves the ground by 26 pt, and both paws fly up 128 degrees, to either side of the head.
10-16: the fall; the paws come back in.
16-17: the landing, squashed to 92%; the ears flap out.
17-27: recovery with overshoot, and the head tips 12 degrees to the right.
27-36: the tilt eases back.

dizzy.name: Dizzy
dizzy.intent: The head goes round in a circle and the eyes go round the other way, twice as fast.
beats: 0-36: the head travels once round an oval 16 pt wide and 10 pt high, wobbling 8 degrees each way.
0-36: the body sways 4 degrees each way about the ground point, a quarter of a cycle behind.
The eyes go round twice, 2.5 pt from their centres.
The ears swing 18 degrees, the right one 4 frames after the left.
The front legs brace apart; the tail hangs.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.intent: The head sinks and tips to one side, the eyes shut, the tail curls in. Dimmed to half to spare the screen.
beats: Enter, 24 frames: the head sinks 14 pt and tips 9 degrees, the ears relax outward, the figure dims to 50%.
0-60: one slow breath, 2.5% of the body's height; the head rides 2 pt on it.
44-52: the right ear twitches 12 degrees and springs back (a dream).
20-40: the tail tip lifts 6 degrees and settles.

poke.name: Poke
poke.intent: A single tap. Added to whatever state is playing.
beats: 0-2: a flinch. The figure squashes 6% in height, the head ducks 6 pt, the ears pop out 20 degrees, the eyes widen.
2-8: the rebound overshoots to 103%.
8-14: the ears and tail spring to rest.
